properties.q_0_field_before_command: Before S3 can govern command it presupposes a substrate to carry it and a runtime to inhabit — S0's socket/process ground beneath the listener, S2's Neo4j/Redis beneath session and presence state (S3 'also hosts spacetime + redis-context at S3'', CLAUDE.md II.C). As the S-family's manifestation of the raw #3 archetype (Pattern/Process, CLAUDE.md II.A), S3's void-pole is the un-routed field: a connection not yet handshaken, a request not yet validated, a session not yet bound to identity — the bare socket that has opened but to which no governed response, no lineage, no authority has yet been assigned. This is the thrown ground S3 stands upon: that there is transport at all, a wire that can carry frames, prior to any law about which session a frame belongs to or what subagent may inherit from what parent. 'A session is not first real because it is displayed somewhere; it is first real because S3 has accepted and governed it' (S3.md) — so S3's q_0 is exactly the moment before that acceptance: the ungoverned invocation, the raw addressability that precedes sovereignty. The horizon S3 lives upon is command-as-possibility: an open command plane that can route, persist, and emit anything precisely because it has not yet routed this. Before session authority, the bare connection that consents to be governed; before the imperative plane acts, it is merely reachable.
properties.q_1_gateway_control_plane: S3 IS the Gateway Control Plane — 'the imperative plane of the stack … the layer where command becomes lawfully actionable: the place where a participant, operator, or client addresses the system and expects a governed response. Its task is not merely transport. Its task is sovereignty at the level of invocation' (S3.md). Against the other S-layers it is the one that 'makes it temporal and routed' (S-SYSTEM-INDEX) — where S0 grounds, S1 resides, S2 stores, S3 GOVERNS COMMAND. Its substance is the stable WebSocket/RPC command surface with Epi-Claw Parity as 'a hard compatibility requirement rather than a vague aspiration' (S3.md): the runtime in Body/S/S3/{gateway, gateway-contract} that 'accepts socket connections, emits a hello-ok frame, negotiates protocol/features, requires a connect handshake, validates method payloads, executes gateway-owned mutations, emits ordered events, and returns structured responses or structured errors.' It is also 'the authority layer for Session identity' — binding a session to canonical key, aliases, day identity, NOW path, workspace root, bootstrap scope, and subagent lineage (S3.md). The strict boundary defines it: 'imperative command belongs to S3; shared synchronized world-state belongs to S3'' — S3 'validates, routes, persists, emits, and governs, but does not pretend to be the whole world. It is the control plane, not the inhabitable field.' Definitionally S3 is the manifestation of #3 Process in the technology stack: the sovereign command-and-session plane where invocation becomes governed action. (PAI/plugin/harness readings 'remain part of the genealogy … but they are no longer the target shape' — S3.md.)
properties.q_2_routes_governs_emits: S3 moves by GOVERNING and EMITTING — its native act is the connection-and-authority lifecycle: it 'validates, routes, persists, emits, and governs' (S3.md). The operations are concrete (S3.md p2): connection and authentication lifecycle; gateway-owned command, chat, session, config, channel, node, and approval surfaces; session identity, workspace, bootstrap, and subagent lineage law. Its method manifest is a real families' grouping — connection/transport, agent runtime, chat runtime, session authority, config/system control, skills/models, channels/temporal control, node/device/browser/approval — and its event fanout is 'concrete rather than symbolic: agent, chat, tick, health, and heartbeat are named event families with sequence semantics and reconnect implications' (S3.md). S3 couples in two directions and is actualised by four ta-onta carriers (S3.md): Chronos gives command 'a lawful cadence, schedule, and recurrence surface'; Khora binds 'session authority to root, day, and NOW inheritance'; Hen ensures gateway-bound identity 'corresponds to real vault structures'; Anima turns gateway authority 'into dispatchable multi-agent action'; Aletheia carries 'the consequences of command toward the shared-state plane of S3'.' The relational signature is governance-of-lineage: S3 'decides which session a run belongs to, what subagent may inherit or spawn from what parent, what workspace and bootstrap scope apply' — the authority that makes invocation belong to someone. It does not inhabit the world; it routes the command that acts on it, then hands consequence up to S3' for rendering as shared state.
properties.q_3_torus_two_plane_architecture: S3's organising structure is the TORUS — the live node carries this topology, and it is its home register and deepest structural truth: the gateway is a self-enclosing request/response/event loop. Structurally S3 is governed by the Two-Plane Architecture (S3.md p3): 'imperative command belongs to S3; shared synchronized world-state belongs to S3'.' This is the constitutive seam — S3 owns 'command execution first: run registration, transcript writes, session mutation, terminal snapshot caching, event emission, and operator-facing truth about the runtime,' while S3' 'only takes over once those imperative consequences must be rendered as shared state.' The loop closes: a connection opens (hello-ok), handshakes (connect), issues governed methods, receives ordered events with sequence/reconnect semantics, and its consequences fold up into the shared field — the torus of governed invocation. The structural laws that hold it non-degenerate are the parity and authority contracts: Epi-Claw Parity means 'behavioral equivalence of the command plane' (an epi-claw-shaped client receives 'the same category of capability with truthful semantics'), and 'no fake completeness: if a surface is not real, it should be absent or explicitly unsupported rather than claimed under a parity banner' (S3.md). Session authority is a real identity law: canonical key primary on the wire, NOW-native identity as alias/metadata, the session record bearing canonical key, alias, label, active agent, subagent lineage, workspace root, bootstrap scope, team/orchestration metadata, and NOW-facing lineage (sessionId/dayId/vaultNowPath). The pattern is a governed command-torus: a closed invocation loop whose every frame is validated, whose every session is bound, and whose every consequence routes lawfully toward the shared-state plane.
properties.q_4_sovereignty_at_invocation: S3 exists to be SOVEREIGNTY AT THE LEVEL OF INVOCATION — so that command is not merely transported but lawfully governed, so that every run belongs to a real session with a real lineage. Its telos is the imperative plane: 'the place where a participant, operator, or client addresses the system and expects a governed response … sovereignty at the level of invocation' (S3.md). Its genealogy is the fourth manifestation within the S-family — #3 (raw archetype Pattern/Process) → S3 (Gateway Control Plane), the descent of Process into the technology stack as the governed command-and-session loop. Its locality in the S-SYSTEM-INDEX system image is exact: 'S3 makes it temporal and routed,' the layer whose primary data authority is transport, session state, temporal events, Redis session/context state, and Graphiti runtime architecture. Its purpose is sharpened by what it is NOT: it 'does not pretend to be the whole world … the control plane, not the inhabitable field' (S3.md) — and by its open structural questions (when NOW-native naming should become primary session identity, where the public/remote exposure boundary sits, what stays in epi gate vs richer clients like OmniPanel). OmniPanel compatibility 'is not decorative': renderer controller expectations, main-process gateway-client behavior, and parity tests 'are part of the shape of S3 itself.' Read teleologically, S3 is why a session is REAL: not because it is shown, but because S3 has accepted and governed it. Purpose: to be the sovereign command plane where invocation becomes governed, lineage-bearing action.
